L03-R3-AMT-002.decision: CMS 11b medical supplies include dressings/splints/casts, distinct from prosthetics and diabetes supplies. EOC prosthetic-related supplies cost 20%, hospital supplies are bundled in applicable outpatient cost, SB DME has its own 0%/20% distinction. None proves a universal standalone 0% medical-supply charge. Preserve these subtypes; hold the flat medical-supply claim.

L03-R3-AMT-013.decision: PBP selects worldwide benefit and foreign-service copayment. Chapter 7 reimbursement instructions do not settle that price. Publish coverage/reimbursement caveat only; hold the exact foreign urgent/transport price and waiver as a same-basis claim.
